title: Encore AI raises $30M to build AI agents that learn from customer calls
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: The startup analyzes calls, messages, and CRM data to identify effective sales techniques and turn them into playbooks for AI agents.
body:
Encore AI has successfully raised $30 million in Series A funding, signaling a significant step in its mission to revolutionize customer interaction through advanced AI agents. The company, which recently rebranded from Insait IO, is building a platform that trains AI voice agents by meticulously studying real-world customer support and sales conversations. These sophisticated agents are designed to either seamlessly integrate with human teams, offering real-time assistance, or operate entirely autonomously, handling customer engagements directly.

The core of Encore AI's technology lies in its unique "interaction mining" process. This involves analyzing a rich dataset of customer communications, including call recordings, emails, and text messages, all integrated with CRM systems. The platform dissects these interactions, identifying specific conversational stages and pinpointing which human strategies, anecdotes, or even jokes consistently lead to successful outcomes. These proven "playbooks" are then used to train the AI agents, enabling them to replicate the most effective communication tactics observed from top-performing employees.

This innovative approach matters significantly to developers and researchers by demonstrating a powerful method for creating highly adaptive and context-aware AI. Instead of relying on generic scripts, Encore AI's agents learn directly from the nuanced, successful strategies of human experts, pushing the boundaries of practical AI application in customer-facing roles. For businesses, this translates into enhanced customer engagement, improved sales conversion rates, and the ability to identify and rectify inefficiencies within their existing support and sales workflows, ultimately leading to more effective and personalized customer experiences.
